commands.command: set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; echo '=== observer tmp ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell 'cat /data/local/tmp/aicall_appdeath_observer.txt.tmp 2>/dev/null || true'; echo '=== observer process tree ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell 'ps -A -o USER,PID,PPID,NAME,ARGS | awk '"'"'$2==10459 || $3==10459 {print}'"'"''; echo '=== observer proc ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell 'cat /proc/10459/wchan 2>/dev/null || true; echo; tr "\0" " " </proc/10459/cmdline 2>/dev/null || true; echo'; echo '=== call/bluetooth ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | grep -m1 'mCallState='; echo bluetooth_on=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '\r'); echo observer_stall_snapshot=true
commands.output:
=== observer tmp ===
=== observer process tree ===
=== observer proc ===


/system/bin/sh: can't open /proc/10459/cmdline: No such file or directory
=== call/bluetooth ===
    mCallState=0
bluetooth_on=1
observer_stall_snapshot=true

commands.command: set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; echo '=== logcat latency ==='; START=$(python3 -c 'import time; print(time.monotonic_ns())'); adb -s "$SERIAL" shell 'timeout 3 logcat -d -v brief >/dev/null 2>&1'; RC=$?; END=$(python3 -c 'import time; print(time.monotonic_ns())'); echo logcat_rc=$RC logcat_ms=$(( (END-START)/1000000 )); echo '=== cleanup stale observer ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell 'kill -9 10459 2>/dev/null || true'; sleep 0.2; if adb -s "$SERIAL" shell 'test -d /proc/10459'; then echo stale_observer_alive=true; exit 1; fi; echo stale_observer_cleaned=true
commands.output:
=== logcat latency ===
logcat_rc=0 logcat_ms=572
=== cleanup stale observer ===
stale_observer_cleaned=true
